notablePrerequisites:
Three loyalty counters on Spark Double.

description:
Activate Spark Double's first loyalty ability by adding 0 loyalty counters, dealing 3 damage to target creature and having that creature deal 1 or 2 damage to Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers but fails to transform.
You must repeat the last step in a mandatory loop, resulting in a game draw.
